description: Defines utility structures and functions for counting tensors and variables, index sequence manipulation, and variadic function application within the torch namespace.

classes.name: CountTensors
classes.description: A functor for counting tensors in various argument types.

classes.name: CountVariables
classes.description: A functor for counting autograd variables in various argument types.

classes.name: Indices
classes.description: A template struct representing a sequence of indices.

classes.name: MakeIndices
classes.description: A template struct for generating index sequences in reverse order.

methods.name: count_tensors
methods.description: Counts the number of tensors in the provided arguments.

methods.name: count_variables
methods.description: Counts the number of autograd variables in the provided arguments.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a function to a variadic list of arguments in order.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks arguments and applies a function, returning a specified type.
